verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a locally installed, Arch-based Linux desktop distribution, not a hosted service that stores user data in vendor-operated regions. Choosing a storage region or residency is therefore a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows Omarchy operating a cloud data store with region selection, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
